```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nflfastR)
library(nflreadr)
```

```{r}
regular_season_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/regular_season_success.csv")
postseason_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/postseason_success.csv")
close_game_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/close_game_success.csv")
aggressiveness_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/aggressiveness_score.csv")
two_minute_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/two_minute_score.csv")
division_game_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/division_game_success.csv")
player_dev_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/player_dev_score.csv")
coaches <- read.csv("../../data/raw/coaches.csv")

```

```{r}
team_seasons <- coaches %>% 
  rename(season = Year, offense = Offense, coach = Coach, defense = Defense) %>% 
  select(season, team, coach, offense, defense) %>% 
  filter(season > 2014 & season < 2026)
```

```{r}
scores <- team_seasons %>% 
  left_join(player_dev_score %>% select(season, team, coach, player_dev_percentile, offense_dev_percentile, defense_dev_percentile)) %>% 
  left_join(regular_season_score %>% select(season, team, coach, win_percentile)) %>% 
  left_join(postseason_score %>% select(season, team, coach, playoff_percentile)) %>% 
  left_join(close_game_score %>% select(season, team, coach, close_win_percentile)) %>% 
  left_join(aggressiveness_score %>% select(season, team, coach, aggressiveness_percentile = wp_percentile)) %>% 
  left_join(two_minute_score %>% select(season, team, coach, two_minute_percentile = wp_percentile)) %>% 
  left_join(division_game_score %>% select(season, team, coach, division_win_percentile)) %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(score = sum(c_across(6:last_col()))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# best coaches since x year
best_coaches <- scores %>% 
  filter(season > 2015, season < 2022) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(coach, offense, defense),
    names_to = "role",
    values_to = "coach_name"
  ) %>% 
  separate_rows(coach_name, sep = ",") %>% 
  mutate(coach_name = str_trim(coach_name)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(coach_name), coach_name != "") %>% 
  # Assign weight by role
  mutate(score_weighted = case_when(
    role == "coach"   ~ score,      # head coach full score
    role %in% c("offense", "defense") ~ score * 0.25,  # assistants get half
    TRUE ~ score
  )) %>% 
  group_by(coach_name) %>% 
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    total_score = sum(score_weighted, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_score = total_score / seasons,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(avg_score)) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  select(rank, coach_name, seasons, total_score)

best_coaches
```

```{r}
# best coaching seasons since 2015
best_seasons <- scores %>% 
  filter(season > 2016) %>% 
  group_by(season, team, coach, offense, defense) %>% 
  summarise(score = mean(score)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(desc(score)) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  select(rank, season, team, score, everything())

best_seasons
```


```{r}
write.csv(best_coaches, "../../data/processed/total_coach_scores.csv")
write.csv(best_seasons, "../../data/processed/best_season_scores.csv")
write.csv(scores, "../../data/processed/season_scores.csv")

```
